parsed.quote: The owners of a popular Brooklyn novelty shop pushed back amid a wave of online vitriol Sunday after Kelly Clarkson claimed she'd gotten the so-called "Pretty Woman" treatment during a recent visit, saying that the item the "American Idol" star wanted to buy was the store's mascot, which wasn't for sale.
parsed.reason: The article reports on a dispute regarding a bird automaton mascot but makes no mention of a Kelly Clarkson cutout, its authenticity, or the storefront's display.
